annotations.title: Posted pay for each kind of sales role

description: Today's posted pay for every kind of sales role: the median and the 25th to 75th percentile of the figures employers state, with the number of figures and employers behind each. A kind is included only when at least three employers state pay for it. Call it when the user asks what a sales role pays, such as a first-line sales manager or a VP of sales. It returns no roles; to find roles above a pay figure, call search_sales_jobs with min_pay_usd.
name: get_sales_pay
